name: autopi-monorepo
description: AutoPi desktop and command-line AI agent with event-driven Wake automation

scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build:desktop
scripts.build:core: cd packages/tui && npm run build && cd ../telemetry && npm run build && cd ../ai && npm run build && cd ../agent && npm run build && cd ../session-backends/sqlite-node && npm run build && cd ../../protocol && npm run build && cd ../client && npm run build && cd ../server && npm run build && cd ../coding-agent && npm run build
scripts.build:offline: cd packages/tui && npm run build && cd ../telemetry && npm run build && cd ../ai && npm run build:offline && cd ../agent && npm run build && cd ../session-backends/sqlite-node && npm run build && cd ../../protocol && npm run build && cd ../client && npm run build && cd ../server && npm run build && cd ../coding-agent && npm run build
scripts.check: biome check --write --error-on-warnings . && npm run check:pinned-deps && npm run check:ts-imports && npm run check:shrinkwrap && npm run check:install-lock:coding-agent && tsgo --noEmit && npm run check:desktop && npm run check:browser-smoke
scripts.generate:models: npm --prefix packages/ai run generate-models && npm --prefix packages/ai run generate-image-models
scripts.test: npm run test:scripts && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.version:patch: npm version patch --workspaces --include-workspace-root --no-git-tag-version --no-workspaces-update && node scripts/sync-versions.js && npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts
scripts.version:minor: npm version minor --workspaces --include-workspace-root --no-git-tag-version --no-workspaces-update && node scripts/sync-versions.js && npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts
scripts.version:major: npm version major --workspaces --include-workspace-root --no-git-tag-version --no-workspaces-update && node scripts/sync-versions.js && npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run clean && npm run build && npm run check
scripts.test:vscode: npm --prefix apps/vscode run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/vscode test
